name: Kevin (Tze Siang) Vun
title: Founder & Therapist (Counsellor & Psychotherapist)
description: Works with individuals and relationships who feel stuck, overwhelmed, or disconnected. Areas: relationship & attachment challenges; 'Identity, Sexuality & Life Transitions' for those exploring identity, sexuality, belonging; addiction and compulsive patterns incl. 'people using substances, sex, porn, work, or other behaviours to manage emotional pain'. Practice offers EMDR, psychodynamic and humanistic therapy for anxiety, depression, trauma; couples work inclusive of ENM and non-traditional partnerships. Gottman Level 3. No Medicare; in person Collingwood, online across Australia.
specialties: EMDR, trauma, sexuality, identity, addiction, sex/porn compulsivity, couples, ENM, Gottman

name: Lachlan Anthony
title: Registered Psychologist & Clinical Registrar
description: Non-pathologising, compassionate and inclusive. Integrates CBT, ACT, Schema Therapy, Internal Family Systems, and EMDR to support trauma-related distress, grief, relational difficulties, depression and anxiety; IFS Level 1 and EMDR Levels 1 and 2. Areas include complex trauma, PTSD, LGBTQIA+. In-person Thu/Fri; online Mon/Wed.
specialties: EMDR, IFS, schema therapy, complex trauma, PTSD, LGBTQIA+

name: Parris Davenport
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Works with adults and young people 16+ with complex mental health issues; 'I have experience working with LGBTQIA+ identifying people.' Uses CFT, CBT, DBT, Internal Family Systems, Schema Therapy and Sensorimotor Psychotherapy; eating disorders, autism & AuDHD, attachment. Not taking clients.
specialties: IFS, schema therapy, sensorimotor psychotherapy, LGBTQIA+, eating disorders, AuDHD

name: Neehara Ravikumar
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Down-to-earth approach drawing from CBT, DBT, ACT and Schema Therapy, plus psychodynamic and culturally-informed care. Works with anxiety, low mood, stress, self-esteem, performance anxiety, athletes, couples and cultural diversity. Mondays & Fridays.
specialties: schema therapy, DBT, athletes, couples, cultural diversity

name: Tess Jennings
title: Registered Psychologist (Accredited Eating Disorder Clinician)
description: 'As an openly queer clinician, I work with LGBTQIA+ individuals exploring identity, internalised homophobia and transphobia.' Works frequently with people navigating intersections between gender identity, neurodivergence, eating disorders, trauma, and body-related distress. Offers gender-affirming care, neuroaffirming care, trauma-informed support; psychodynamic and attachment-oriented, guided by social justice principles. Mondays & Wednesdays.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, gender identity, gender-affirming care, eating disorders, trauma-informed, CBT-E, psychodynamic
identity: 'an openly queer clinician'; 'my positionality as a white, able-bodied, cisgender woman'

name: Perri Ashton
title: Senior Registered Psychologist (Educational & Developmental)
description: Works with adolescents and adults with anxiety, depression, trauma-related concerns, and life transitions. 'My approach is trauma-informed, neurodiversity-affirming, and person-centred. I draw on EMDR therapy', plus ACT, CBT and mindfulness. Mondays & Tuesdays.

name: Dr Felisha Thain
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Uses CBT, ACT, DBT, mindfulness and self-compassion; interest in eating disorders, body image, social anxiety, panic and OCD; autism assessments. Works with adults 18+ and 'passionate about creating an inclusive space that affirms all identities, including LGBTQIA+ and neurodivergent individuals.' Tuesdays & Saturdays.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, eating disorders, OCD, autism assessment, DBT

name: Jerome Scaffidi
title: Registered Psychologist & Clinical Registrar
description: Works with adults experiencing anxiety, depression, trauma, and difficulties in relationships, self-worth, and emotional regulation; experience with suicidality and serious illness. Draws primarily from ACT, EFT, EMDR, and somatic mindfulness-based approaches; existential psychotherapy and Buddhist psychology. Tuesdays & Wednesdays.
specialties: EMDR, trauma, EFT, existential, somatic, mindfulness

name: Maria Zhang
title: Mental Health Counsellor
description: Level 3 Mental Health Counsellor (ACA) working with ages 15+; extensive experience with ADHD and Autism, helping clients integrate their neurodivergent identity. 'I always aims to create a neurodiversity-affirming, trauma-informed, inclusive and culturally-informed space.' Can incorporate Mandarin Chinese & Thai. Fridays.
specialties: neurodiversity, ADHD, autism, trauma-informed, culturally informed, Mandarin, Thai
identity: 'my own multicultural upbringing and lived experience'

name: Micole Liong
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Client-centred; incorporates CBT, DBT, ACT, Mindfulness, MI and Psychodynamic Therapy. Areas: Attachment Trauma/Complex Trauma, BPD, emotion dysregulation, ADHD. Tuesdays & Sundays.
specialties: complex trauma, attachment trauma, BPD, DBT, psychodynamic

name: Grace Clarke
title: Registered Psychologist & Clinical Registrar
description: 'My therapeutic approach is relaxed and affirming, and I enjoy providing inclusive care that celebrates the identities of neurodiverse and LGBTQIA+ individuals.' Works primarily with adults, experience with 16+. LGBTQIA+ affirming, neuroaffirming. Thursdays.

name: Dr Ashley Kenny
title: Registered Psychologist (Counselling)
description: Integrative practitioner (CBT, mindfulness, CFT). 'I have a keen interest in mind–body approaches, with specialist experience in persistent pain management, adjustment to chronic health conditions, PTSD and complex trauma.' Works with people 16+, including culturally diverse, LGBTQIA+, and neurodivergent communities. Tuesdays & Fridays.
specialties: PTSD, complex trauma, chronic pain, LGBTQIA+, OCD, CFT

name: Adrian Fix
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Person-centred; draws mainly from ACT and CBT. Supports anxiety, depression, OCD and neurodivergent individuals. 'I also have experience supporting LGBTQIA+ identifying individuals.' Mon, Tue & Fri.

name: Azara Harris
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Works with depression, anxiety, personality disorders, and past trauma; uses CBT, DBT and Schema Therapy plus CFT. Areas include PTSD and disordered eating. Wednesdays & Fridays.
specialties: schema therapy, PTSD, trauma, DBT, personality disorders

name: Sarah Branchflower
title: Senior Registered Psychologist
description: Supports adults and adolescents with anxiety, perinatal mental health, trauma, stress, parenting. Integrates CBT, EMDR, mindfulness, schema therapy, psychodynamic and solution-focused therapy. 'I have a particular interest in using EMDR therapy to process trauma and core beliefs.'
specialties: EMDR, trauma, schema therapy, perinatal mental health, parenting
